title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Camerupt Mega Brave 077/063 Super Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Mega Camerupt ex SR 077/063 M1L Mega Brave Japanese Pokemon card is a highly sought after collectible card from the Pokémon TCG set. This special EX card features a full art design of the character Camerupt and is considered super rare. Originating from Japan, this card is a valuable addition to any Pokémon card collection, especially for fans of Camerupt and collectors of rare cards.
